notes.title: Campground Update + 30% Off Sale Soon?
notes.notes:
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/865/857/3a22aa632bbf891c52965b2a05383e4e_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1474828174&auto=format&q=92&s=d40993dfb30b10baf368d0a8b79d16a3[/img]

The campground update is out now. (Steam should update it automatically?) Here was the trailer for it again:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LNdxFg0_rPY
Sorry for the wait, kept thinking it was done but kept needing to redo and change some things which would sometimes break other things, it's a problem.

Tried to make different things fancier like the AI and pathfinding but almost nothing was really working right so just reverted everything to the old way which was fine. The evil chickens act a little goofy now though. 

Also figured out how to do sales? So there should be one here soon for 30% off which should last a bit (Assuming it works -.-)

Anyway, attempted something different with this region, some of the main issues were that stuff was kind of hard to find, intelligence gating, stamina/HP running out and some things were overly-complex. So here stuff respawns, no intelligence gating (there's only a couple gated things), stuff is pretty straight forward like the crystal caves aren't maze-like at all. This is a good region to go if you need to fill up your stamina and health too.

And everything is revealed (except the areas) in the menu. This is to show that it's different from the other regions, it's supposed to be the refresher region. (Though there are some things to find and collect.)

Comment below or something if you thought this was a nice region to sort of refresh in.

Again it's probably not as extravagant as the other regions but shouldn't be as complex and got the important stuff in so that's good. Also did something different with one of the new creatures, the turtle. You can't kill the turtles and they just sort of wander around, sometimes not seeing where they are going. Originally had it so you could ride them but it kept causing problems, you would get permanently stuck to them when they turned.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/866/580/bc31aa9782ff3abd5937a11ab2342577_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1474832886&auto=format&lossless=true&s=9a81325a4ca6ee1fdbcbcd6b57d40369[/img]
[list]
    [*]1 New Cosmetic
    [*]1 New Animal Friend
    [*]2 New Den Decorations
    [*]1 New Trophy
    [*]4 New Creatures
    [*]5 New Foods
    [*]New Region: Green Peak Campgrounds
    [*]New Area: Crystal Caves
[/list]

And are you tough enough to enter the Salty Spitoon?

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/865/948/0f4b8d26842f9aad1f5b8ef06cef350a_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1474828658&auto=format&q=92&s=143ae31f87381676c3fd0777f23ece77[/img]

Might remove or change this later. -.-

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/866/585/d2aaeede3aff0f6dbe781daf19758cfa_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1474832898&auto=format&lossless=true&s=b4e3f0bcbea71dace36627c7cecbe396[/img]

Changed a bunch of textures, for example the mud texture in Arni Forest:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/865/955/794ae40405543552c8af0a7ad1c118f7_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1474828690&auto=format&q=92&s=afedeed1745a64f656c89ea4fe5a34fe[/img]

Made the Gorge and Lake more colorful.

Updated the Shadow Pig model, it looks cooler now. The birds stay the same though. The all around terribleness of the birds is their charm:

[b]Steam Updates:[/b]

But was having trouble figuring out things to do for everyone along with deciding who should be put in, not wanting to play favorites, etc. Basically it was too difficult to try and include everyone while keeping things even so came up with this idea as a replacement:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/865/981/2b094c7f5a91b0bd2f3954ed04b9f032_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1474828820&auto=format&q=92&s=0819d61847096ad069a4dbc26fa34695[/img]

Leave a comment or message others you want to see on the wall. (And preferably give an image to use.)

They probably should have played before this update though.

Not sure how many will be able to be put up so this might be a temporary thing. Also might need to readjust the placement and sizes so they're not final.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/062/364/aa8bfa3eec99bba429c862b15880d879_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1476170914&auto=format&lossless=true&s=ac001959c5bf8168eac18cf353cb5c0f[/img]

Kept redoing stuff and cut out a few things, most of which was pretty unnecessary. Here's a few behind the scenes things:

First of all there were a few cows that wandered around but that would take the mystery out of [i]you know[/i] so left them out.

There was also a quest that involved oranges:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/062/399/1df04880be00e853bb3a02c7fa7856c8_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1476171301&auto=format&q=92&s=0cbf2401a602f554bf38235473370026[/img]

It involved animal markings mostly but it was kind of dumb and overly complicated so just took it out. The oranges are still there though.

The secret area was supposed to have something bigger than whats there:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/233/594/976429ffd697e54ce74729cf877ad37a_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1477275249&auto=format&q=92&s=fd23d1699071a044c9aea9817eb34d10[/img]


But it was just confusing and added nothing except to make the story more complicated so kept it out.

There was also a few things with the warehouse that was toned down for the same reason.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/866/592/fac9bac8c0aa276b01923102b1e2c816_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1474832927&auto=format&lossless=true&s=aa2b968778976dd0a036273c9e03c2eb[/img]

[list]
[*]Forgot to add colliders for rain in the Campground so rain will go right through roofs and stuff, not a terrible problem.
[*]Campground creatures might have too much HP, could probably lower them.
[*]Again the Evil Chickens have AI/Pathfinding issues. They act odd, like they will face away from you and attack.
[*]Also tried again to fix the shadow shimmering again, see if that worked.
[/list]
Was going to add this to the cave under the bear goals but thought it was too dumb:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/866/001/ab7f1d4a19048604f467a67040392b1c_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1474828899&auto=format&q=92&s=b51fa9cf1d161f4cd585e8b2dc9be484[/img]

What's a good way to tell people that pressing the number 5 will help unstick you if you get stuck? Add it to the store page?

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/870/206/a8779e38709af7faae53557c70949542_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1474859031&auto=format&lossless=true&s=ecdea78a90b08832d6724215073db751[/img]
[list]
[*]Fixed the Coast mushroom spawning on top of the KS Island teleport mushroom.
[*]Fixed the cups having a stone texture. (and made them red.)
[*]Made the beds recover percentages of HP/Stamina again. If you want to fully fill your stamina/HP either upgrade your bed or go to the Campground now.
[*]Fixed the Pirate skin not being selectable.
[/list]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/866/601/f42d40c98cd4286a7ea7d19dbaec5f98_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1474832961&auto=format&lossless=true&s=0e8722396e0d0633091d903ed048f502[/img]
[list]
[*]Might be glitches. Tested it a bunch though so maybe not? Am aware of the pathfinding problems with creatures in the Campground though -.- Everything else should be back to the same way they were but there might have been leftover bugs. The new Shadow Pigs might have problems.

[*]There's probably other small things changed not listed on here.

[*]Didn't really add many Easter eggs or hide stupid things on the textures this time (there's a few though.)

[*]There is no fast travel shroom for the Campgrounds, there's a purpose for that.

[*]There aren't any animal markings, was doing something with stealing a fish from the warehouse. They weren't terribly popular?

[*]Couldn't put this on sales like midweek madness or stuff like that, pretty sure you need to be invited to that.

[*]May adjust, remove and change things so some stuff might be temporary.
[/list]
Again this region should be casual and pretty straight forward (though there is a few secrets to find). All in all it should be refreshing and an easy way to build up your stamina and health (and bear points).

You can't go there at night right off though, you need to figure out a way to remove the darkness first. (Then do one more thing.)

This was kind of wordy, was building up a bunch of stuff. Might be spelling errors. Rewrote this like 20 times -.-

Again there should be a 30% off sale here.

Hope you like this update :O

P.S. Finally got the hang of this Steam announcement thing. Except there's a few spacing problems -.-

P.S.S. Did no one get this reference with the pirate skin?:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/014/062/332/c47ff174086fb3142955064a4af5d13b_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1476170523&auto=format&q=92&s=76ab9a2aae01a06d73eae24dc9a7c47a[/img]

notes.notes:
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/049/492/05bcbf79645d5297b0158ae9a21a4ec0_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1468437654&auto=format&q=92&s=d4ed4c90fc11989663258472e9ea257e[/img]

 Hi, first of all watch the people from Penny Arcade play this bear game:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fvcAKh07CGk

It was funny seeing them trying to figure out things and what's going on. Like their comic so it's as exciting as when the Game Grumps played this bear game. Wasn't sure if they liked it or not though.

Anyways, still working on the campground dlc. Here's some behind the scenes stuff in the mean time:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/049/540/acd8feb14b8a436b42d2c751ade595d1_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1468437904&auto=format&lossless=true&s=6e12d4d591c450f30df76519f1ffdce0[/img]

Arni Forest went through a ton of revisions, it had a vacation house where you would have found a kitchen (with food), some storyline stuff (the humans there left behind some messages) and a bird animal buddy (which eventually became DJ Raven):

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/049/551/8614e7366e31435af4611543d59f6dad_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1468437958&auto=format&q=92&s=62c1c1c64cba63789dfb09c7c1f75a8c[/img]
(The pink color means the texture is missing)

There was also a hedge maze that was cut too:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/049/558/710f3220c664b9a6b3a05e9a3d2cf524_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1468438004&auto=format&q=92&s=5f11d3c9d8670fb0d9fb2dae55e9fe0e[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/049/568/7419adeed49442596b909d138c6e0c0e_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1468438043&auto=format&lossless=true&s=b634f0da9c7879ed6ee8a46a74c1f9c7[/img]

Originally Bear Points were used as a gating system. At first you'd need a specific amount of bear points to travel to new regions. There would be “Barriers” blocking you from certain regions, kind of like “Note Doors” in Banjo Kazooie:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/049/573/201f980c484a5c36beb5aed792f825cd_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1468438061&auto=format&lossless=true&s=8cd02035561099bac4cc08b873c3896e[/img]

Things got shifted around a bunch and intelligence blocked food was used as a barrier system so you couldn't just travel around without building your stats up first. Bear points were originally used instead of Intelligence for food gating.

Intelligence had a different role, it was used to interact with the environment more. For example there was locked doors you couldn't open and books you'd need to read to gain new abilities and items like so:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/049/577/c99a19a2bdf362059ee2e7a0d38a72a9_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1468438093&auto=format&q=92&s=6dbef90522f4e522a24421217c4ebd33[/img]

You'd need to read a book and collect items to make a cat bed instead of just finding it. Plus there were other books for things.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/049/582/16013442b108af61b4cb58235d9d5365_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1468438111&auto=format&lossless=true&s=26fd28bc5be2111b633d35d970dfa944[/img]

That mystery shed went through a bunch of revisions. The main, original plan was it contained another key (inception sound here):

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/049/590/030a323ef01664083c311994d69e814a_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1468438136&auto=format&q=92&s=366b290dca9afe345b0840b2934d0486[/img]

This would have given you special access to Kickstarter Island which was planned to be an exclusive region. Changed this when people messaged wanting their friends and favorite Youtube people to see their island submissions without needing the secret code. Plus wasn't sure if it should have been an exclusive thing or not or what people were expecting, didn't know how to go about it really, kept overthinking it.

Next idea was to have a switch that would spawn frogs everywhere in Arni Forest:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/049/594/87a213680a9c5d91cd079e97c1f92df3_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1468438164&auto=format&q=92&s=f380ca70c3870daf3e3805941abcebd6[/img]

You would have to kill them all and be rewarded with something.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/049/600/308bf16d7c677e673c7d44d398aedb72_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1468438197&auto=format&lossless=true&s=a162186cf8563609ddb04436105fd6d4[/img]

Was reading this comic called Hunter x Hunter but it went on hiatus just when it was getting good. Maybe when I finish the campground dlc thing it will come back just like it came back when finishing this bear game. (?!?!)

Will probably be updating some of the terrible animal models for the campground update (like the pig). But the ducks will keep their terrible models, grown fond of them.

You should watch this show called the Carbonaro Effect, it's pretty entertaining. It's not on Netflix though:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/049/920/e804cfd405557f06dba52f18dc96eea9_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1468439901&auto=format&q=92&s=71e7234c38a33365a0f4846ee9cbd13a[/img]

Also have been playing Pokemon Go.

notes.title: Game Update (Fixes, additions, and upgrades) + Campground Preview (New Cosmetic!)
notes.notes:
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/011/249/831/80e8744ef0255da5a4f1a36a4f6958ca_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1463613629&auto=format&q=92&s=b359bcfbc259278f55181f7858610773[/img]

Ok there's a new game update out, it contains fixes, updates and added stuff.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/011/249/618/a8779e38709af7faae53557c70949542_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1463612186&auto=format&lossless=true&s=337a71e37dc3f864abfd085149403351[/img]

Some things might not be fixed 100%.
[list]
    [*]Fixed the bug with the Web Orb Door.
    [*]Fixed the bug with the evil mushroom.
    [*]Fixed the “Fade in/out” layer not stretching at higher resolutions.
    [*]Fixed a ton of spelling errors. (Forgot to change the marking where Dan Mole refers to himself as Mole Dan though, next update >.>)
    [*]Added colliders to a bunch of things that was missing them.
    [*]MAYBE fixed the shadow and texture flickering. MAYBE.
[/list] 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/011/249/627/d2aaeede3aff0f6dbe781daf19758cfa_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1463612272&auto=format&lossless=true&s=e9e6dd03c194c28c167402694954f408[/img]

[list]
    [*]Made hitboxes bigger on all creatures. (Made pathfinding worse though)
    [*]Fancied up a ton of textures.
    [*]Made the “Unstick” button work waaaaaaaaaay better so if you get stuck all you have to do is press 5 and it will unstick you. (Don't abuse this to get places where you aren't supposed to pls)
    [*]Hella adjusted the lighting in each region. Made the mountain night brighter, toned down the brightness at the beach, etc. etc.
    [*]Readjusted everything at the ocean plus added more things.
    [*]Added a lot more invisible walls to prevent people from getting where they weren't supposed to.
[/list]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/011/249/634/b0af8eb714fdd7ee03db737e20238948_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1463612332&auto=format&lossless=true&s=56d3604da09e2e4a8b936c627d42f5de[/img]

Added a “Return to Den” button. Click it to return to your den no matter where you are.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/011/249/637/03e30bb5a1431693896dc62fec648515_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1463612355&auto=format&q=92&s=17650b19000a4b99ce207fc1e28cf237[/img]

Added fast travel shrooms in your den. When you visit a region a new mushroom will pop up in your den.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/011/249/647/74e0d39f4b52b7ef020dfd3e792a2665_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1463612403&auto=format&q=92&s=1a014b9084748630eea423c18496fe85[/img]

Added some references to the upcoming Campground update.

Added a sponge to be found under the sea (..Kuplinov.. -.-)

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/011/249/688/772ae896516614bf2c1b9757e3210aac_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1463612634&auto=format&lossless=true&s=96e08777dc898bf144d5ad4b67a1c493[/img]

Tried to make the graphics better but it cause an extreme performance drop, then tried to revert it but it still left a bunch of performance problems. There might be a fps drop for some.

Probably introduced a ton of programming bugs after trying to reorganize the scripts.

As stated before the animal pathfinding is probably worse with the bigger hitboxes, hopefully it's worth it.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/011/249/694/f42d40c98cd4286a7ea7d19dbaec5f98_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1463612667&auto=format&lossless=true&s=299eef529dc832947e7c678063a8b94e[/img]

People are inquiring about this symbol:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/011/249/695/791cf83bed8a573ab679a3b695f7829f_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1463612679&auto=format&q=92&s=ff04391c1c2696cb948b79bc16443b7e[/img]

For a hint check the door in the cave. Also it isn't the symbol of the evil chickens.

Also movie recommendation, people should watch this movie called Legend. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/011/249/702/df5ef98e611a57002ca8688b9a2c94a2_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1463612722&auto=format&q=92&s=3900fad1c3fd1e12297e7ddd6c472a11[/img]

It's friggen weird and Tom Cruise has long hair in it plus there's unicorns and a weird evil guy played by Tim Curry. Directed by the same guy who did Alien!

Also here's another teaser trailer:

https://youtu.be/b4X9T2pJUVo

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/011/249/647/74e0d39f4b52b7ef020dfd3e792a2665_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1463612403&auto=format&q=92&s=1a014b9084748630eea423c18496fe85[/img]

Added some references to the upcoming Campground update.

Added a sponge to be found under the sea (..Kuplinov.. -.-)

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/011/249/688/772ae896516614bf2c1b9757e3210aac_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1463612634&auto=format&lossless=true&s=96e08777dc898bf144d5ad4b67a1c493[/img]

Tried to make the graphics better but it cause an extreme performance drop, then tried to revert it but it still left a bunch of performance problems. There might be a fps drop for some.

Probably introduced a ton of programming bugs after trying to reorganize the scripts.

As stated before the animal pathfinding is probably worse with the bigger hitboxes, hopefully it's worth it.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/011/249/694/f42d40c98cd4286a7ea7d19dbaec5f98_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1463612667&auto=format&lossless=true&s=299eef529dc832947e7c678063a8b94e[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/011/249/695/791cf83bed8a573ab679a3b695f7829f_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1463612679&auto=format&q=92&s=ff04391c1c2696cb948b79bc16443b7e[/img]

For a hint check the door in the cave. Also it isn't the symbol of the evil chickens.

Also movie recommendation, people should watch this movie called Legend. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/011/249/702/df5ef98e611a57002ca8688b9a2c94a2_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1463612722&auto=format&q=92&s=3900fad1c3fd1e12297e7ddd6c472a11[/img]

It's friggen weird and Tom Cruise has long hair in it plus there's unicorns and a weird evil guy played by Tim Curry. Directed by the same guy who did Alien!

notes.title: Campground Update Preview #3: New Features and Stuff
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/wUJwBIW.jpg[/img]

Still working on the Campground update. It will have the Campground region open, new items to find, a new animal buddy, new areas, more story stuff, bug fixes and new features that were requested. Let's take a look at some of these new features.

[b]New Features:[/b]

Fast Travel!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/bALXKQk.jpg[/img]

Whenever you visit a new region a mushroom will pop up for it in your den. Eat it to travel to that region.

Easy Mode!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/IV3YQRc.png[/img]

A new option in the main menu that will max your stats so you don't need to bulk up before traveling to new regions.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Fixed the Web Orb Door bug, the spooky mushroom bug and many others.

[b]Lastly[/b]

Still have lots to do but all this and more will be in the campground update.

Will leave you with this blog post about a cheap pop culture reference:

[url=http://farjay.com/post/143727587848/its-always-sunny-in-bear-simulator][img]http://i.imgur.com/GsBm6XL.jpg[/img][/url] 

[url=http://farjay.com/post/143727587848/its-always-sunny-in-bear-simulator]http://farjay.com/post/143727587848/its-always-sunny-in-bear-simulator[/url]
